added.summary: GPU particle simulation now runs through a slab-allocated Mega-Pool with batched wave compute passes, GPU sub-emitter event queues, alive-index compaction, indirect draws, tight alpha-cutout billboard cropping, and half-resolution soft-particle rendering with bilateral depth upsampling.
EffectMesh draws use a dedicated instanced renderer with full Weighted Blended OIT support, and alpha-blended trails, hooked billboards, and effect-material mesh particles participate in OIT.

added.member: FX volumetric fog, distortion & temporal reactivity
added.summary: Forward particles, effect meshes, and ribbons sample the 3D volumetric froxel volume at true depth; distortion particles refract the full lit transparent scene with bilinear sampling and depth rejection; and transparent FX stamp TAA/FSR3 reactivity cleanly.

fixed.summary: Fixed missing emitter velocity in `ParticleHistory`-backed ticks (restoring `inheritVelocity`), prevented `time_scale` changes from resurrecting stopped emitters past `stopTick`, added sub-tick emitter motion interpolation and gentle `collision die` parity on CPU, added `Capsule` collider support to `og.particles`, and rebased `particle_history` and `effect_meshes` on render-origin shifts.

fixed.member: og.Vfx determinism, streaming, leaks & bundle release
fixed.summary: Eliminated per-row JSON decoding from FX/collider extraction, made `before_tick` particle-only with live tick rate, separated uninterpolated simulation transforms from blended display transforms, added streamed `TextureArray` residency checks for VFX emitters, reclaimed finished child `AudioSource`/`Flipbook` entities on looping/persistent VFX, and guarded `og.load.release` against live `ParticleEmitter`/`EffectMaterial`/`VfxAsset` references.

Always emit `gravity 0 0 0` on zero-gravity Effekseer emitters, fix ring midpoint color sampling, 3-axis mesh spin, `SingleFCurve` parsing, open circle arc endpoints, line-to-spline emission, advanced material/force-field mappings, static parent folding, `emitter_references` for `shape mesh`, shader `param` bounds checking, `plan_effect`/`plan_vfx` dependency tracking, and `vfx2d` clamping.
